svg.title: Well 3 - Hot-Water Preheating Example
svg.desc: Source water 33°C, 80 t/h; hotel demand 300 t/day; mains-water reference 13°C. Avoided heating = 300 × 4.187 × (33-13) / 3.6 = 6,978.33 kWh/day. At boiler efficiency 0.85 and gas heat value 10 kWh/m³: about 821 m³/day. At RMB 3.2/m³: RMB 2,627.2/day; source annual result RMB 958,905. Excludes avoided water purchases. Source units and rounding contain inconsistencies; gas price is interpreted as RMB/m³.
